title: Vite + React + TS app with scripts dev, build, typecheck, test, e2e. Tailwind v4, self-hosted IBM Plex Sans and Mono, tokens.css per docs/DESIGN.md
acceptance: cd frontend && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build

title: scripts/gen_types.sh generates src/api/generated.ts from contracts/openapi.json. Typed openapi-fetch client in src/api/client.ts
